title: VLMProbe: An Open-source Library for VLM Probing and Interpretation
abstract: arXiv:2610.33072v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Understanding how vision-language models use visual information requires connecting internal representations to model behavior. We present vlmprobe, an open-source library that integrates lens readouts, attention attribution, causal interventions, and sparse autoencoder (SAE) analysis within a common model interface. Shared adapters, calibration and checkpoint utilities, evaluation pipelines, and visualizations support systematic analysis across architectures. Using this framework, we compare methods across vision-language, language, and vision models through matched case studies and controlled evaluations of pretrained sparse dictionaries. The comparisons show that representation readouts and spatial explanations depend on the analysis objective and observation site, and that local attribution estimates can disagree with measured intervention effects. translated_title: VLMProbe：一个用于视觉-语言模型探测与解释的开源库
translated_abstract: 理解视觉-语言模型如何利用视觉信息，需要将模型的内部表征与其行为联系起来。我们提出了vlmprobe，一个开源库，它在统一的模型接口下集成了透镜读取、注意力归因、因果干预以及稀疏自编码器（SAE）分析。共享的适配器、校准与检查点工具、评估流水线和可视化功能支持跨架构的系统化分析。利用该框架，我们通过匹配的案例研究和对预训练稀疏字典的受控评估，在视觉-语言模型、语言模型和视觉模型之间对各类方法进行了比较。比较结果表明，表征读取和空间解释依赖于分析目标和观测位置，且局部归因估计可能与实际测得的干预效应不一致。SAE评估进一步揭示了重建保真度方面存在的明显权衡……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出了开源库VLMProbe，将探测读取、注意力归因、因果干预和稀疏自编码器分析统一在同一接口下，用于系统比较和解释视觉-语言模型的内部表征如何与模型行为相关联。
en_tdlr: VLMProbe is an open-source library that unifies probing readouts, attention attribution, causal interventions, and sparse autoencoder analysis under a common interface to systematically interpret how vision-language models connect internal representations to behavior.
